verdict.rationale: The axis applies because a SaaS mobility platform could ship AI-generated insights. However, nothing in the evidence mentions AI-generated insights or suggestions. The 'personalized advice' and 48-hour eligibility assessments come from human case managers, attorneys and in-house experts, not AI working on the user's in-product data. Automated renewal reminders and status tracking are adjacent features, not AI insights.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
